payload.core_mechanism_summary: Computes minimum swaps to sort sequence of three unique values by counting pairwise value misplacements between original and sorted sequences using Counter arithmetic.
payload.rationale: Solution uses sorted(s) to define target order and then relies on counting mismatches via collections.Counter and set-like operations; this aligns loosely with sorting with a custom key as it manipulates sorted order, but no explicit key function is defined.
